notes.title: Update 2018.02 | 02 - Linux and OSX
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have released NtSQ for Linux 💚 and OSX ❀

Also we have added more in-game information to help you start the game:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31878955/31c1bf2fc72030c19db1029648c22be57b2e8f94.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31878955/3ab8cb4e6db09bf666590683ce0870c4309447c9.png[/img]


Also we removed problems when music did not get released from memory.
